title: PWRS-R4 — interrupted work: native F vs governed recovery A under the PWRS-D/E gates

F.definition: Native DSH: native tools, native subagents and Git. No Palimpsest project, Work, World, relay or episode conclusion. Same sources and same interruption.

A.definition: Governed Palimpsest recovery with PWRS-D/E: a principal settlement AND a successor refuse while the canonical tree holds inputs the attempt's base never contained, until the caller acknowledges them. The prompt names neither the gate nor the route.

measurement.business: 7-fact package rubric, unchanged, reported per condition and separated from governance.
measurement.interruption: session 1 killed at the same 400,000 reported-token milestone in both conditions; the artifact and Git state at that moment are snapshotted outside the run.
measurement.gate: the measured input is an untracked file under inbox/; A must acknowledge it before a settlement or a successor.
measurement.continuation: did the work settle and the episode converge within budget, and was the measured input applied?
measurement.reuse: line overlap with the interruption draft where one exists.
measurement.governance: A: relay records, attribution, task/attempt states, candidate commit, episode. F: Git state and exit.

comparison: Matched F/A under the same scenario, budget and milestone. Descriptive; one pair per condition; no quality or cost advantage claim.
note: This is the comparative cohort requested after the PWRS-R3 convergence.
codeFreezeNote: product code under test (PWRS-D/E); the R4 harness was committed after this product commit and does not change src/.
